{{Quote|No, this isn't my ship. It's a royal starship from the Bimin Three system, on extended loan for the Jedi.|[[Garen Muln]]|<ref name="Deceptions">''[[Jedi Apprentice Special Edition: Deceptions]]''</ref>}}
The '''Bimin Three system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Majoor sector/Legends|Majoor sector]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Its inhabitants were friendly to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].
